meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去发现本机已有的 OpenClaw 安装,读出身份、频道凭据、定时任务等,再分步和你商量要迁移哪些、如何在 NanoClaw v2 里归属,并在改动前展示方案。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate from openclaw”“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”时,技能就会启动。

say.text: 把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 会先扫描并总结本机 OpenClaw 里的内容。

say.text: 迁移我的身份和 Telegram 群聊
say.note: 会确认名称、群组归属和策略后再执行。

say.text: 看看 OpenClaw 里有哪些定时任务
say.note: 会列出任务并和你讨论如何映射到 v2。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude detects an existing OpenClaw installation, reads its identity/channel credentials/scheduled tasks, and runs an interactive migration into NanoClaw v2: it summarizes findings, agrees what to move and where, shows changes before applying, and masks credentials.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user says 'migrate from openclaw', 'openclaw migration', or 'import from openclaw'.

say_en.text: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2.
say_en.note: Claude scans and summarizes the local OpenClaw setup first.

say_en.text: Migrate my identity and Telegram groups.
say_en.note: Confirms names, group mapping, and policies before applying.

say_en.text: What scheduled tasks are in OpenClaw?
say_en.note: Lists tasks and discusses how to map them to v2.
